data.body:
FIX-FORWARD LANDED. Change 1733 merged as 2af5a4c773 ("Only stamp the sweep clock when a sweep
ran"). The stamp hole is off main — verified against the merged tree, not assumed:
`run_sweep`'s `finally` block on main is now `release_trigger_lock(tracker, fd)` alone, with no
`record_sweep`.

So all five defects that rode in on the stale 1727 are now corrected on main:
1. stand-aside stamping the sweep clock (the hole through the floor) — fixed here;
2. `| tee` under pipefail masking rebar's exit code — fixed here;
3. untested dry-run stamp guard — test added here;
4. double `record_sweep` per successful sweep — resolved by fix 1;
5. `_config_schema.py` over the 800-LOC cap — fixed independently by the peer session's 1732
   ("Restore the module-size gate", ea6ee67e6a), which split the file to 677 lines. That one was
   never mine to fix and I did not touch it; it blocked 1733's CI until it landed, which is why
   1733 took a -1 I correctly declined to recheck.

The unblock sequence worked exactly as recorded in the standdown note: 1732 landed → I rebased
1733 onto it → re-pushed → LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 on the corrected revision → submitted.

Remaining on this ticket's story: `mesodermic-vaporish-seaslug` (the sweep-scale fix — one
history walk per sweep instead of per ticket, hoisted out of the lock; scoped staging; mid-run
re-yield). Implemented and committed as b8345508c9, both tiers running. This ticket stays
in_progress until that lands, because the sweep it enables is currently the thing stalling the
fleet.
